environment_constraints: network OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22 must be put on PATH explicitly each shell. The screenshot harness renders WebGL headlessly via SwiftShader; it captures a FIXED-camera still (chef/coach/pet have locked cameras, wardrobe has OrbitControls). For issue 2 (chef arms mid-gesture) the harness captures a fixed still and speaking is only true briefly after a send; to prove arms move, capture with a scripted send or accept that arm motion is best evidenced by a short scripted-interaction screenshot — the coder should drive `speaking` via a query param/DOM interaction in a custom capture step if needed, or document the code path proof plus a still.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Create ONE new branch off main: fix/scene-and-voice-polish. Commit only source + docs/fixes evidence. Never commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, assets-src/. Preserve WS1-WS4 merged wins (see key_patterns).
key_patterns: WS1 (perf): chunk split, SceneLoader/useProgress fallback, on-demand loading, asset() on EVERY public URL, cold-load byte budget. WS2 (visual): shared High/Fast quality via components/three/quality.ts + single QualityToggle; ACESFilmicToneMapping on all four scenes; no skin blow-out. WS3 (interactivity): clicks route through lib/chef|coach engines, lib/pet state, wardrobeOptions — no parallel path; CameraRig PINNED_CAM/PINNED_LOOK additive-offset math must stay valid. WS4 (a11y): usable at 390x844 and 1280x900, no horizontal scroll, keyboard path + visible focus, prefers-reduced-motion gating via components/three/useReducedMotion.ts (verified: returns false by default, correct), canvas role='img' aria-label text alternatives. Scenes use next/dynamic { ssr:false } so WebGL/DOM never runs during static export.
directory_structure: app/ = routes (page.tsx landing maps over lib/data.ts projects; app/projects/{coach-trainer,chef-chatbot,digital-wardrobe,virtual-pet}/page.tsx). components/ = scene + UI components grouped by feature (pet/, chef/, coach/, wardrobe/, three/ shared). lib/ = engines + state + voice + asset() helper + data.ts content. scripts/ = measurement harnesses. public/models/characters/ = 3D assets. docs/ = per-workstream evidence.

diagnosis_findings.issue1_pet: Measured schnauzer.glb raw bounds: size x=1.00 (LONGEST=nose-to-tail body length), y=0.83 (height), z=0.44 (SHORTEST=side-to-side width). center x=-0.181,y=0.391,z=0.015. Camera sits on +Z looking toward -Z, so the camera faces the dog's NARROW side (width along Z). The dog's forward/nose axis runs along X, perpendicular to the camera => 'seen from the side, head not visible'. FIX: rotate the inner recenter group ~+/-PI/2 about Y (and optionally a small yaw for three-quarter) so the nose faces +Z (the camera). Sign (+ or - 90deg) must be verified by screenshot since which end is the head is not yet certain (mass shifted toward -X suggests head is the denser end). Apply rotation to the inner <primitive>/recenter group, NOT the animated whole-group (whose identity rest the useFrame absolute-offset math depends on). Re-verify Box3 recenter AFTER rotation so framing stays centered. Keep AIM_HEIGHT/CAMERA_DISTANCE camera rig valid or adjust with justification+screenshot.
diagnosis_findings.issue2_chef_arms: Measured: the raw FBX has all 6 arm bones + jaw (Bip001_R/L_UpperArm/Forearm/Hand, Bip001_Jaw) and they ALL resolve via getObjectByName both on the raw FBX and AFTER SkeletonUtils.clone. Rest rotations are non-zero (arms tucked at sides). Writing bone.rotation DOES update matrixWorld. So the bone-name/rig hypothesis is FALSE — names are correct. The mechanical write path is sound. Therefore the real-world 'arms don't move' is most likely (a) `speaking` visually reads as no-motion because amplitudes are subtle relative to the tucked rest pose within the fixed head-and-torso framing, and/or (b) a perception issue vs the jaw. The coder MUST re-confirm at runtime (headless: load scene, force speaking=true, sample an arm bone rotation across frames to prove offsets are applied) and make the gesture UNMISTAKABLY visible (increase amplitude within the frame, ensure gestureRef eases toward 1 while speaking). Verify reduced-motion still damps arms to rest (gTarget = reducedMotion?0:speaking?1:0).
diagnosis_findings.issue2_coach_arms: CONFIRMED: coach is a STATIC UNRIGGED OBJ (public/models/characters/coach/coach.obj) with ZERO bones/skeleton (README + CoachScene comments + code). It physically CANNOT move arms — only whole-group bob/sway/lean exists today. This must be surfaced honestly in the report: the coach has no arm rig, so 'arms move' is impossible; instead make its existing whole-group talking motion more believable/visible (larger/clearer bob+sway+lean while speaking) OR clearly explain no arm motion is possible. Do NOT invent a fake rig.
diagnosis_findings.issue3_voices: chefVoice.ts forces pitch 0.7 / rate 0.9 (the extreme low pitch is the primary 'robot' cause) and prefers an Italian-accent voice. coachVoice.ts already uses rate 1.05 / pitch 1.0 (natural-ish). Both use Web Speech API getVoices(). Improve within Web Speech ONLY: move pitch toward natural (chef ~0.9-1.0 not 0.7), keep rate natural, PREFER higher-quality named/enhanced/cloud voices and AVOID the lowest-quality fallback (e.g. prefer voices whose localService is false or names containing 'Google'/'Natural'/'Enhanced'/'Premium'/named OS voices), keep robust across browsers. MUST keep onStart/onEnd speaking-window callbacks + all anti-stuck-engine mitigations intact (issue 2 chef mouth/arm timing depends on them). HONESTY CONSTRAINT: a truly non-robotic neural voice would require a NEW TTS dependency/asset/service which is NOT static-export-safe — do NOT add one; STOP and flag it in the report instead.
diagnosis_findings.issue4_wardrobe: WardrobeBuilder.tsx: lg:grid-cols-[minmax(220px,260px)_1fr_minmax(220px,260px)] — stage is the middle 1fr flanked by two 220-260px menus; container minHeight:760; stage main has min-h-[420px]. WardrobeScene.tsx has OrbitControls + camera framing. 'Avatar space too small' => give the stage more room (widen center column / reduce side menu max widths / increase stage min-height) AND/OR tighten camera framing so avatar fills the stage. Must NOT reintroduce horizontal scroll or cover controls at 390x844, must NOT break OrbitControls turntable/zoom or the reduced-motion autoRotate gate. Verify at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900.
